mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate level directly increases equity discount rates, compressing present values of future cash flows and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or shows no statistical significance (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 5.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuation multiples, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has a positive coefficient in 20-day SPX return regression or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly), rising wage pressures accelerate inflation expectations and preemptive rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances during tight labor market regimes.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output capacity and earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0.

mechanism_narrative: A lower industrial production level (INDPRO) directly correlates with reduced corporate output and weaker equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 5-day SPX returns is negative and statistically insignificant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1900.0 thousand units signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, boosting corporate revenue expectations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1900.0.

mechanism_narrative: Annualized CPIAUCSL inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting delayed monetary tightening and reducing equity risk appetite, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL annual inflation rate > 3.0%.
